snippet.title: Old Stuff: Dai Senryaku VII: Modern Military Tactics intro [Xbox, 2005]
snippet.description: Remember this? I had totally forgot about this even i've had it for years. Upcoming version for PS3 and Xbox 360 was just announced recently and then i finally decided to dig out my old import Xbox from storage and take a proper look at this gem. This is not actual gameplay, but intro video plus some games own presentation. Note: US game on US Xbox, i don't think this was never avalable for purchase in Europe? Later there was a PS2 vrsion released in US, i'm not sure if that was ever released in EU either? The new upcoming game with eight player online play is confirmed only for Japanese release at this point, those who are intressed should take a look here: http://community.us.playstation.com/thread/3416427
